schema_version.description: A newer major is read-only for this build; a newer minor is read and written with unknown fields preserved.

id.description: topic:<title, whitespace collapsed, case-folded> | quarantine:<note stem> | migrated:<NNNN> | update:<note stem> (1.1). Unique in the store. Never changes.

origin.description: Who created the entry. Never changes. A minor schema bump may add a value (update: 1.1, discovery: 1.2).

status_by.description: operator, or the writer that last set status: harvest | propose | quarantine | regrade | migration | scout | review | research.

status_written.description: The status the module last wrote. Absent or different from status means an operator changed it.

scope_area.description: discovery entries (1.2): the scope area whose pass found the topic.

source_urls.description: discovery entries (1.2): the sources the scout gave; replaced by the latest sighting.

category.description: discovery entries (1.2): the coverage category the scout proposed.

proposed_filename.description: discovery entries (1.2): the filename the scout proposed.

reason.description: update entries (1.1): why the note is queued. new_material outranks operator outranks review_due; a reason is only replaced by a stronger one.

prompted_by.description: update entries (1.1): the source URLs that prompted the update; accumulated, deduplicated.

as_of.description: update entries (1.1): the note's own as_of date when last seen (YYYY-MM-DD).

outcome.description: update entries (1.1): how the worked update ended. Cleared into outcome_history when the entry reopens.

attempts.description: update entries (1.1): failed attempts since the last passing outcome or new prompting source. At pipeline.update_max_attempts the entry is set aside (still open, no longer queued).

last_failure.description: update entries (1.1): why the last attempt failed.

outcome_history.description: update entries (1.1): earlier outcomes, oldest first, each {outcome, cycle?}.
